card.name: Digits and decimal points inside number ranges

modes.label: Times in a range
modes.description: The point or colon or digit inside the end time of a clock range.

modes.label: Dose or measurement ranges
modes.description: A digit or decimal point partway through the upper value of a numeric range in dose tables or measurements.
